source = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A separator is a full line in a color used nowhere else in the grid.
    separators = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and sum(v == row[0] for line in grid for v in line) == w:
            separators.append(("row", r))
    for c in range(w):
        value = grid[0][c]
        if all(row[c] == value for row in grid) and sum(v == value for row in grid for v in row) == h:
            separators.append(("col", c))
    axis, index = separators[0]
    if axis == "row":
        block = [row[:] for row in grid[index + 1:]]
    else:
        block = [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in block for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[4 if value == background else 3 for value in row] for row in block]
'''
task_file.write_text(source)
print(task_file.read_text())
